name: Albert Marquet

summary.text: Albert Marquet was a French painter. He initially was one of the Fauve painters and a lifelong friend of Henri Matisse.

20184222: Sergeant of the Colonial Regiment is an oil on canvas painting by French artist Albert Marquet, from 1906-1907. It is held in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, in New York.
47261460: The Citadel of Tangier is a 1913 painting by French artist Albert Marquet, using oils on canvas glued to a card background. It is held in the Museum of Grenoble.
